UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user profile containing authenticated account metadata and language preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Private email address (restricted to owner only).

DeviceRegistration.title: DeviceRegistration
DeviceRegistration.description: Publicly addressable by exact unique device code (no PII) for consent-based pairing discovery.

ownerName.description: Public display name of the device owner.

sharingActive.description: Whether the device is currently sharing its screen.

PairingRequest.title: PairingRequest
PairingRequest.description: Explicit consent-based pairing relationship and connection history between two devices.

requesterUid.description: UID of the user requesting connection.

requesterDeviceCode.description: Unique code of the requesting device.

requesterDeviceName.description: Model name of the requesting device.

requesterName.description: Display name of the requesting user.

targetOwnerUid.description: UID of the target device owner.

targetDeviceCode.description: Unique code of the target device.

targetDeviceName.description: Model name of the target device.

targetOwnerName.description: Display name of the target device owner.

participantUids.description: 2-element array containing [requesterUid, targetOwnerUid] for participant-scoped queries.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Real-time text message or screen-sharing session notification inside an accepted pairing.

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender.

messageType.description: User text or session start/end notification.

ScreenShareSession.title: ScreenShareSession
ScreenShareSession.description: Consent-gated WebRTC screen sharing session with SDP signaling and expiration.

pairingId.description: Accepted pairing document ID authorizing this session.

hostUid.description: UID of Device A sharing the screen.

viewerUid.description: UID of Device B viewing the screen.

offerSdp.description: Optional WebRTC SDP offer published by Host after consent.

answerSdp.description: Optional WebRTC SDP answer published by Viewer.

IceCandidateRecord.title: IceCandidateRecord
IceCandidateRecord.description: WebRTC trickle ICE candidate exchanged between Host and Viewer.

participantUids.description: Denormalized 2-element array of session participant UIDs.

role.description: Peer role generating the ICE candidate.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profile isolated strictly to the authenticated owner.

/devices/{deviceCode}.description: Device registry keyed by unique device pairing code (no PII).

/pairingRequests/{requestId}.description: Consent-based pairing requests, paired devices, and connection history.

/pairingRequests/{requestId}/messages/{m.description: Paired user text messages and session lifecycle notifications.

/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Consent-gated live WebRTC screen sharing sessions and SDP signaling.

/sessions/{sessionId}/iceCandidates/{can.description: Trickle ICE candidates for active WebRTC screen sharing sessions.
